page.overview:
What is Josephina Flint?

Minister Josephina Flint was a British witch who served as the thirteenth Minister for Magic of the British Ministry of Magic, in office from 1819 to 1827. She was elected at least twice.

She revealed an unhealthy anti-Muggle bias in office and disliked new Muggle technology such as the telegraph, which she claimed interfered with proper wand function.
